title: Diagnostic utility of smartphone-integrated gait analysis in the assessment of BPPV
authors: Durmus K, Bora A, Sapci B, Al-Hazzar MK, Akti K, Kekul Sapci M, Altuntas EE
direction: 方向4：BPPV/前庭康复 — 智能手机步态分析（家庭/基层评估趋势）
abstract: BPPV is the most common vestibular disorder causing gait disturbances. Smartphone-based gait analysis has emerged as a portable, cost-effective alternative to laboratory-based assessments. Objective: evaluate the diagnostic utility of smartphone-based gait analysis in BPPV patients and its effectiveness in assessing treatment outcomes.
note: 智能手机步态分析评估 BPPV 及疗效 — 家庭/基层 BPPV 评估趋势佐证, 与 kwon2026 IMU-CRP 互补
